summary: Hom Hak Chak Suan (“Love from the Garden”) is Jing Jai’s Wednesday morning farmers market, offering locally grown organic vegetables alongside breakfast food, coffee and other drinks. It is a useful midweek stop for a relaxed breakfast or produce shopping, but the operator’s description does not promise the broader craft-market selection found on weekends.
whyGo: Visit a farmers market on a weekday: the operator lists it every Wednesday, 06:30–12:00.
Browse vegetables grown by local gardeners and pick up breakfast or a drink in the same visit.
The operator says visitors can drive into the Jing Jai site and use its parking.
bestFor: Travellers in Chiang Mai on a Wednesday morning
People interested in local produce and an easy breakfast
A low-key alternative when the weekend farmers market does not fit the itinerary
skipIf: You are visiting on another weekday or expect the market to run every day.
You want the full weekend craft market or a guaranteed large choice of stalls.
You need confirmed accessible routes, facilities or stall-level payment information.
duration: Allow 1–2 hours as a planning estimate for breakfast and a browse; no official visit duration is given.
cost: No admission charge or current stall prices were stated in the operator information reviewed. Budget separately for food, drinks and produce; amounts and payment methods vary by vendor and are unconfirmed.
hours: The operator lists Hom Hak Chak Suan every Wednesday from 06:30 to 12:00. Individual stall hours and any later schedule changes are unconfirmed.
bestTime: Go around 07:00–09:30 for a morning market visit and breakfast, leaving time before the stated noon close. This is a planning suggestion, not a guarantee of when each stall opens.
gettingThere: Use Jing Jai Market, 45 Atsadathon Road, Pa Tan, Chiang Mai as your destination. The operator says visitors may drive into the project and that parking is available; spaces at a particular time were not verified. A taxi or ride-hail is another practical option from central Chiang Mai. Exact public-transport connections were not confirmed.
booking: No reservation process is listed; plan as a walk-in market visit. For a schedule check, the operator lists +66 53 231 520 and infojingjaicm@central.co.th.
accessibility: The operator mentions on-site parking, but step-free routes, accessible toilets, path surfaces, seating and stall access were not documented in the sources reviewed. Contact the operator if you need specific access arrangements.
practicalTips: Bring a reusable bag for produce; Jing Jai encourages visitors to avoid plastic bags.
Carry some cash and check payment options at individual stalls; these were not confirmed centrally.
Ask vendors directly about ingredients and allergens before ordering prepared food.
Treat Wednesday as a produce-and-breakfast market; check separately if you are seeking crafts or a specific stall.
decemberNotes: For December 2026, Wednesday falls on 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 December. The operator currently describes the market as weekly, 06:30–12:00, but has not published a December 2026 calendar or holiday exceptions. Recheck the official activity page or contact Jing Jai shortly before your chosen date, especially for 30 December.
uncertainties: The operator page confirms the weekly schedule and launch date (17 June 2026), but does not provide a December 2026 event calendar or holiday closure information.
Stall count, vendor list, prices, payment methods and exact opening times within the published market window are not stated.
Detailed accessibility and public-transport information were not found.
